packages.name: Hugging Face Sync
packages.view: Copies a GitHub repo into a Space and adds the Space header so the Hub page can open.
packages.ours: We keep the Space header only inside huggingface/dreamco-router/README.md. GitHub pages stay plain.

packages.name: Sync GitHub to Hugging Face Hub
packages.view: Official action. Uses the hf tool to upload a folder as a Space, model, or dataset.
packages.ours: This is the one workflow we installed. It uploads only the beginner-router folder when you run it.

packages.name: Sync With Hugging Face Space
packages.view: Keeps a separate YAML file and sticks it on the README only on the Space.
packages.ours: Same idea, already done by hand in the router README. We do not run this second uploader.

packages.name: Sync With Hugging Face Hub
packages.view: Older community uploader for model, dataset, or Space.
packages.ours: Studied. Replaced by the official hub-sync action so we do not keep two uploaders.

packages.name: Hugging Push
packages.view: A push of the current repo into a Space repo.
packages.ours: We do not push the whole DreamCo repo. Notes and plans stay on GitHub.

packages.name: Hugging Repo
packages.view: Same job as Hugging Push: mirror repo files to a Space.
packages.ours: Treated as a duplicate lesson. One uploader is enough.

packages.name: Deploy to Spaces, models, or datasets
packages.view: One action can target a Space, a model repo, or a dataset repo.
packages.ours: The workflow asks which of the three you want each time you run it.

packages.name: HF Model Inspector
packages.view: Reads a public model card and writes a short report about size and use.
packages.ours: Our report is the model card plus the 12-prompt check. We do not inspect someone else's weights.

packages.name: MLX Model Doctor
packages.view: Checks a model folder before load: config, tokenizer, shards, memory.
packages.ours: We have no MLX weights. The lesson is: do not load a model until a check passes.

packages.name: Auto release with an AI description
packages.view: Writes a release note by sending the change list to a model.
packages.ours: Boot camp does not send the repo to an outside model to write release notes.
